The Reve API - Reve Blog Pricing API Blog Start Creating The Reve API July 14, 2026 Today we're launching the Reve 2.1 API. Build directly with the world's best 4K image model and the layout model powering it. Create and edit in native 4K and compose with total control. For the first time, you can create with Reve's layout model. Two years ago, our team bet on layouts as an intermediate representation for images: hierarchical, structured regions that encode visual information. By restructuring images as code, every element becomes addressable, editable, and manipulable. Creative controllability is built into visual intelligence by design. Layouts also speak to something more fundamental: what it means for a machine to understand an image, and how that visual understanding translates to a new plane of action. Until now, an agent could describe an image and receive it, but not work inside it. Because a Reve image is code, an agent can now speak to it directly, reading its structure, analyzing how the parts relate, and changing any single element with intent. When an agent can reason with an image, not just render it, visual intelligence gains a new dimension. Today, we are making the Reve Layout available outside of Reve.com , through the Reve API. We're opening our model to your imagination, to the creative automations, prototypes, and production-grade workflows you're building. Two years ago, we bet that images should work like code. Today we are opening that bet to everyone building with visual intelligence. Code with images, with the Reve 2.1 API. The Reve 2.1 API is divided into two categories: Ready to use. Straightforward and familiar endpoints for creating and editing images. Full Layout Control. More complex and powerful endpoints that decouple layout creation, editing, and rendering. Reve 2.1, Production-Ready Augment and automate creative workflows across marketing, game development, real estate, film production, and much more. A single Create endpoint covers most integrations on their own. 4K on every generation. Working at high resolution matters for real production workflows across digital work and physical media. Our novel rendering architecture generates images at native 4K x 4K resolution, true 16 megapixels, no upscaling step. Consistent style and content reference. An aesthetic eye on every render. A subject, palette, or brand system holds across scale, so a whole campaign stays on-brand. Fluent and unique in graphic design, typography. Scalable, easy integration. Generate and edit as many images as your pipeline needs, with consistent stylistic control and a straightforward REST API. Full Control with Layouts A set of experimental endpoints for full control. Agent-native by construction. The REST APIs, combined with Reve's skill.md file, bring the full power of the Reve 2.1 APIs to your coding agent. Because Reve images are code-based, agents can both "see" them and reason about them. Unprecedented controllability. Every region in a layout, its shape, color, and semantics, is independently addressable, so you can change one part of an image without touching the rest of it. Iteration at scale. As the endpoints decouple layout creation, editing, and rendering, you can regenerate just the step that changed, re-render the same layout across a batch of variations, or push one edit across many images, without recomputing the full flow. Accuracy with complexity. Layouts enable increased thinking context per region, resulting in increased precision around small text and complex scenes. Get Started Today that structure is open. Start building with our API console . For high-volume enterprise workflows, contact our sales team . Pricing API Blog About Creative Partners FAQ Support Privacy Terms © 2025-2026 Reve AI, Inc

Launching Reve 2.1 - Reve Blog Pricing API Blog Start Creating Launching Reve 2.1 July 9, 2026 We are releasing Reve 2.1. Just a month after Reve 2.0, our new model makes a rapid leap in visual intelligence and world knowledge. Reve remains both the top 4k model in the world and the highest-ranked independent foundation image model lab on both Arena and Design Arena . The model takes back our spot as second overall, trained at less than a tenth of the compute of the labs ranked above and below us. Dense scenes, fine text, and intricate structure, all at native 4K. Click to expand and explore. Reve 2.1 extends the same foundation of controllability, but sharpens it at every stage with intuitive prompt understanding and stronger foreign-text rendering. The model plans in finer detail, reasons more accurately about how elements relate, and renders the result with greater precision at native 4K. Visual intelligence and layout planning. The model reasons about structure, hierarchy, and spatial relationships before it renders, excelling at dense and complicated scenes. Precision editing. Every element is addressable and editable, so a single region can be changed and re-rendered Pristine 4K output. Renders at a full 16-megapixels, preserving every sharp edge and texture through iterative changes. Multilingual text rendering. Dense, legible type set inside the image, now extended to foreign scripts. Reve is an independent lab training with efficiency, conviction, and focus. Two years ago, our team bet that images should be built like code, with layouts: hierarchical, structured regions. Through this bet, our models build controllability into visual intelligence by design. Reve 2.1 sharpens that control with a model that plans layouts more precisely than ever. For more details on our research, read about Reve's large layout model and the extended reasoning context it enables in The Layout Bet . Create, edit, and iterate freely with Reve 2.1 now at reve.com . Pricing API Blog About Creative Partners FAQ Support Privacy Terms © 2025-2026 Reve AI, Inc

## Model Description (Reve 2.1)
A state-of-the-art image model known for extreme high-resolution outputs, precise text rendering, and robust targeted micro-editing via bounding box selections.
